metadata.question: On July 7, did the coastal city of La Serena have a year-to-date rainfall deficit of larger than 40 percent (compared to the mean from 1990-2020)?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall deficit in La Serena, Chile on July 7th. They want to know if there was a year-to-date rainfall deficit larger than 40% compared to the 1990-2020 mean. Let me break this down: 1. Location: La Serena, Chile (coastal city) 2. Time period: Year-to-date (January 1 to July 7) of the current year vs 1990-2020 mean for same period 3. Data: Need precipitation data 4. Calculation: (current YTD - historical mean) / historical mean * 100 < -40% For precipitation data, I'll use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which is good for rainfall analysis. Steps: 1. Define geometry for La Serena area 2. Get current year YTD precipitation (Jan 1 - July 7) 3. Get historical mean YTD precipitation (1990-2020, Jan 1 - July 7) 4. Calculate deficit percentage 5. Check if deficit > 40% Need to handle: - Check if collections have data - Check if valid pixels exist after processing - Validate calculations ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laSerena = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.2520, -29.9027]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around La Serena // Get current year (assuming 2024, but adjust based on data availability) const currentYear = 2024; const currentStart = currentYear + '-01-01'; const currentEnd = currentYear + '-07-07'; const histStart = '1990-01-01'; const histEnd = '2020-07-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // Current year YTD precipitation const currentYTD = chirps .filterDate(currentStart, currentEnd) .filterBounds(laSerena); // Historical YTD precipitation (1990-2020) const histYTD = chirps .filterDate(histStart, histEnd) .filterBounds(laSerena); // Check collection sizes const currentSize = currentYTD.size().getInfo(); const histSize = histYTD.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Current YTD images: ${currentSize}`); console.log(`Historical YTD images: ${histSize}`); if (currentSize === 0 || histSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation const currentSum = currentYTD.sum(); const histMean = histYTD.mean(); // Check valid pixels const currentCount = currentSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const histCount = histMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Current valid pixels: ${currentCount}`); console.log(`Historical valid pixels: ${histCount}`); if (currentCount === 0 || histCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation values const currentPrecip = currentSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const histPrecip = histMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Current YTD precip: ${currentPrecip?.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Historical mean YTD precip: ${histPrecip?.toFixed(2)} mm`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (currentPrecip === null || histPrecip === null || isNaN(currentPrecip) || isNaN(histPrecip) || histPrecip === 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } const deficitPercent = ((currentPrecip - histPrecip) / histPrecip) * 100; console.log(`Deficit percentage: ${deficitPercent?.toFixed(1)}%`); if (deficitPercent < -40) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
